name: llm-telegram-bot
description: Development shortcuts for the Python Telegram bot; not an npm package.

scripts.format: node scripts/run-python.cjs -m ruff format . && node scripts/run-python.cjs -m ruff check --fix .
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-python.cjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/run-python.cjs -m mypy
scripts.build: npm run build:zip && npm run build:docker
scripts.check:python: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run coverage
scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run build
